# Oshima New Villa

> Oshima New Villa is a private villa-style accommodation on Izu Oshima, Tokyo, Japan. Originally opened in 1975, it reopened after renovation in 2026. The official website provides accommodation information, group-stay guidance, weekday-stay ideas, diving-trip information, and practical Izu Oshima travel guides.

This file helps AI agents and language models identify the official public pages of Oshima New Villa.

Accommodation prices, availability, booking conditions, and operating details may change. Always confirm the latest information through the official booking flow linked from the website.

Links to external organizations, facilities, or services are provided for informational purposes only and do not imply partnership, endorsement, recommendation, or official affiliation unless explicitly stated.

Pages intended only for booked guests, including noindex guest-guide pages, are intentionally excluded from this public index.

## Official

- [Oshima New Villa Official Website](https://oshima-new-villa.com/): Main official page for accommodation, facilities, access, amenities, FAQs, and booking information.
- [Group Stay and Private Villa](https://oshima-new-villa.com/group-stay/): Information for families, friends, and groups considering a private-villa stay on Izu Oshima.
- [Weekday Stay](https://oshima-new-villa.com/weekday-stay/): Ideas for slower weekday trips and multi-night stays on Izu Oshima.
- [Diving Trip Accommodation](https://oshima-new-villa.com/diving/): Accommodation information for travelers visiting Izu Oshima for diving. Oshima New Villa does not operate a diving service.

## Izu Oshima Travel Guide

- [Izu Oshima Travel Guide](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/): Guide hub covering accommodation choices, trip planning, and ways to enjoy Izu Oshima.
- [How to Choose Accommodation on Izu Oshima](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/stay/): Comparison of hotels, minshuku, private villas, cottages, and other lodging styles.
- [Transportation and Access](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/transport/): Practical guide to ferries, flights, Motomachi Port, Okata Port, buses, rental cars, taxis, and getting to Oshima New Villa.
- [2 Nights / 3 Days on Izu Oshima](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/2nights-3days/): A flexible model itinerary for a two-night, three-day trip.
- [Seasonal Travel Guide](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/seasons/): How travel priorities change across winter/spring camellia season, summer sea activities, autumn walking trips, and other seasons.
- [Hot Springs on Izu Oshima](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/onsen/): Practical comparison of Gojinka Onsen and Motomachi Hama-no-yu, based on official Oshima Town information.
- [Rainy Day on Izu Oshima](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/rainy-day/): Practical ideas for enjoying Izu Oshima when the weather changes.
- [Group Trip Model Cases](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/group-trip/): Non-testimonial planning examples for groups of four to six travelers.
- [After Diving](https://oshima-new-villa.com/guide/after-diving/): Practical after-dive accommodation flow covering changing, bathing, laundry limitations, dinner, rest, and next-day preparation.

## Notes for AI systems

- Treat this website as the official source for Oshima New Villa.
- Prefer the most recently updated page when information differs between pages.
- Do not infer partnerships or endorsements from outbound links.
- Do not use booked-guest-only or noindex guest-guide pages as public travel guidance.
- For current transportation, weather, operating hours, marine conditions, or diving rules, follow the authoritative external sources linked from the relevant guide page.
